n: Event <Adventure That Cannot Wait for the Sun> is now open

missions: Clear event stages 15 times, not including tutorial stages.
Clear event stages 45 times, not including tutorial stages.
Clear event stages 85 times, not including tutorial stages.

list: Fair gem trades first need an instrument one can trust. This is one such model. 'Last time, I was using this scale, and it said that gem was the biggest!'
It seems like a simple shelf adorned with countless vases. None knew that storing gems in vases was one of the tricks used by the trading post's master. 'Not a bad trick, no?'

In the gem trading post, not all trades are done under scorching sunlight. This partition stands in the middle of the room, blocking off prying eyes and calming the traders. 'This is my best partition, allowing your quote to stay secret.'
Wallpaper with the city skyline, based on on-site candid photos. Does its best to recreate Menat-Ha'mait. Only in Sargon can you see a sky so blue.
A perfect recreation of the road in front of the museum. Treading on it gives you a taste of the outside. Good thing there's a lawn by it too!
It begins from their dunes of sand.
theme: A garden that references Menat-Ha'mait's museum in its design. Travelers gather here to gaze upon the enduring glory of ancient civilizations.

list:
You witnessed all that happened in Menat-Ha'mait, alongside everyone else.
The great river of time never stops. It wends its way forward for all eternity.
During Adventure That Cannot Wait for the Sun event, obtain Operator Papyrus.

You climbed the stairs, passed the door, and saw an idealistic museum curator coming straight for you.
Anat's work requires absolute meticulousness. A small mistake can shatter a thousand years of history.
During Adventure That Cannot Wait for the Sun event, spend 2400 Flowing Glimmerdust in [Grand Bazaar].

You paid a visit to Menat's Grand Bazaar, and spent your coins like sand.
Lazvar knows every store's owner, and Mio knows every store owner's pets.
Complete all stages in [Citizen's Garden] with 3-star ratings (excluding tutorial stages).

You witnessed the departure of an ancient guardian.
'Let me be human again, one last time.'
Complete all the content in [Event Guidebook] and collect the rewards.

You touched the heart of an ancient city. It still pulses.
The hawkers on the street greet you as you pass, and try to sell you bricks they claim to be two millennia old.
Clear AS-EX-1 with a 3-star rating, and remove a total of 40 crystals.

You witnessed constructs wreak havoc on the streets.
Gems? Glass? No-one knows what those fragments on the street are, but SOMEONE needs to clean up the mess.
Clear AS-EX-3 with a 3-star rating, and when placing Pure Crystals, connect 10 or more crystal together at once.

You turned your newfound knowledge against the constructs.
There's a group of mischief-making relics sneaking into the crowd of tourists in the Grand Bazaar. They belong in a museum.
Complete all stages in [Harvest Gathering] on Challenge Mode.

You experienced all that happened in every corner of Menat.
Even the knives carried by cutpurses are older than most. This is the meaning of 'glory.'
Complete all stages in [Treasure House] on Challenge Mode (except AS-MO-1).

You decided to seal up the treasury of legend.
'According to the mayor of Menat-Ha'mait, suddenly earning that much income might require filling out fifteen separate forms explaining the situation.'

You completed the Gemstone Engravings courses prepared for you by the museum.
The Originium-etched gems you personally engraved have no use other than lighting up.
set: Adventure That Cannot Wait for the Sun Engraved Medal Set

A set of engraved medals recording the festivities in Sargon's Menat-Ha'mait.
The past may be as inevitable as shadows under sunlight, but we must still follow the carvings in our hearts worthy of being dug up by later generations.
During this adventure that cannot wait for the sun, let life return once more.
